symptom: Putting a single order on hold from its row menu makes the whole orders table flash and stutter; every visible row re-renders, not just the one that changed.

truth.cause: OrdersTable memoises onStatusChange with rows in its dependency list (it looks the order up to label the toast). Any data change gives every memoised OrderRow a new onStatusChange, so all rows re-render.

referenceFix.replace:
(order: OrderSummary, status: OrderSummary['status']) => changeStatus({ id: order.id, number: order.number, status }),
    [changeStatus],
